published.citation: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 105: effective temperature in K, 4662 +/- 17, from this work (CHARA): 4662 +/- 17 K, https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/757/2/112

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 16160 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: HR 753 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 753 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 753 is not in the catalogue; burnashev: BS 753 is not in part2), so the colour is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
